name: KV Cache Low-Rank Compression
core_idea: Compress the KV cache by projecting K/V (or their query-aware interactions) into a low-rank subspace, storing only the low-rank factors. KQ-SVD decomposes the query-key interaction KQ^T (not K alone) via truncated SVD, giving a provably optimal closed-form factorization that is robust to K/Q scaling imbalance; it contrasts with K-SVD (compress K alone, ignores Q) and Eigen (joint Q/K/V embedding). The line is training-free but calibration-based (projections learned from a small query set), and trades rank against approximation error of the attention output.
